65 units at "low-income housing levels" (state low-income category, upper limit 80% AMI); split 16 live-work, 19 stacked flats, 19 townhomes, 11 clustered attached

claims.value: Builder's Remedy settlement: 65 low-income units (20% of 323), distributed across all product types; remaining inclusionary obligation paid as in-lieu fee
claims.note: "DeNova shall satisfy any remaining IHO obligations through an in-lieu fee in accordance with Chapter 14.08"

construction_notes.text: Sources disagree on site size: 18.5 acres on the project page, 4.6 acres in the Significant Projects list. Outcome of the Oct. 27, 2026 hearing not found.

Settlement agreement describes the revised plans as 107 motor-court townhomes, 88 townhome-style condominiums, 96 flat-style condominiums and 32 live-work-style condominiums connected to 16 commercial/studio spaces, plus a mixed-use courtyard and a neighborhood park. The city project page lists 16 condominiums and 16 live/work condominiums in place of the 32 live-work units.
City project page: Vesting Tentative Subdivision Map for 147 parcels with five common open-space lots; density 17.5 units per acre; APNs 817-06-006 and 817-06-060.

Settlement agreement: the City agreed to process the project as a Builder's Remedy project, to have the Planning Commission act within 45 days of receiving listed studies, and to apply the impact fee schedule in effect on July 13, 2023. CEQA review is to tier off the 2016 Morgan Hill 2035 General Plan EIR.
